decision.observation: Passed between the trunks: a solo palm stands atop the red ridge crest at center, with pale-green pillar ruins on the ridge's left slope and stacked pale slabs on its right; the dark boulder wall still bounds the right. Red sand slopes up to the crest.
decision.hypothesis: The ridge crest with the lone palm and the pillar ruins above it is the way inland toward the terraces. Walk up the red sand toward the crest.
decision.memory: Ridge crest with lone palm and pale pillar ruins visible through the palms.
